note: What the production reconciler admits. Every image by digest; Relay's own images signed by the release workflow at the release's own X.Y.Z tag, logged, with SBOM, AI-BOM and provenance attestations and a gate-results attestation saying all four gates succeeded, all bound to the same digest. Images signed in verify-only mode after a failed gate carry a gate-results attestation that says so, and are refused. Releases on the revoked list are refused, which stops a rollback to a release later found vulnerable. Third-party images are admitted only through supply-chain/images.json. A tag, a pattern identity or a missing attestation is refused; there is no override in this file.
